newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi Canyon is hot property in US Gulf sale.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi Canyon is hot property in US Gulf sale.

text.p: A cluster of four blocks southeast of the Mississippi River delta proved to be the hot properties in the latest sale of drilling rights in the Gulf of Mexico, analysts said on Thursday.
The four adjoining blocks east and south of Mississippi Canyon 286 pulled in a total $58.1 million in bids from 22 separate bidders vying for drilling rights to the tracts.
Three of the blocks were won by consortiums headed up by Oklahoma City-based Kerr-McGee Corp, which was beaten out by a narrow margin on the fourth tract by Conoco Inc.
